title: stats
description: Numbers side by side, each large under its label: with from, what it was before it and the change under it, for the better or the worse; with a note under it, coloured by its tone

value.description: The number, in quotes as it is drawn: '14.9'. With from, in digits alone, as -3.5, for the change to be counted

from.description: The number before, in digits alone and quotes, as '3.1', drawn small before value; the change is counted under it, to as many decimals as the longer of the two

better.description: Which way is for the better, needed with from and taken only with it

unit.description: Drawn small after the value, such as MB or %

note.description: A short line under the value and the change

tone.description: The note's colour: good for a change for the better, bad for the worse. The colour of the change from from is better's
